faqs.question: How do I enroll in a course?
faqs.answer: Choose the course you want, click enroll, and complete the registration process. You can start learning immediately after enrollment.

faqs.question: How do assessments work?
faqs.answer: Each assessment is designed to simulate exam conditions. Review your score and analytics after each attempt to improve faster.

faqs.question: Are the questions WAEC/WASSCE standard?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our content is built to match WAEC/WASSCE standards, with realistic question formats and grading models.

faqs.question: How do payments work?
faqs.answer: You can pay securely via the payment gateway after selecting a course or assessment. Receipts are issued immediately after payment.

faqs.question: Can I access quizzes on mobile?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our platform is responsive and works across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

faqs.question: How do I get help if I have an issue?
faqs.answer: Reach out using email, phone, WhatsApp, or the contact form. Our support team is available during support hours.
